summaryEvents.text: The plug matches the two outer socket openings. Sensor calibration is complete, and the agent begins the approach.
The pin tips contact the socket face slightly left of the openings. The agent records the contact position and searches toward the openings.
Both wrist views confirm entry. The agent raises the force limit and checks engagement after each alignment adjustment.
The plug remains engaged and has advanced. Reversing the trial rotation reduced bending; the agent checks preload before release.
